meta.model_version: nba v1.0 · trained minutes × rate model
meta.prices_et: No Action Network prices on disk at build time
meta.injuries_et: ESPN injury feed via the data agent (Out / Doubtful removed; day-to-day flagged) · updated 2026-11-06T01:26Z
meta.factors_per_prop: 22 minutes inputs + 33 rate inputs per market

calibration.note: Temperature on the log-odds, fit walk-forward month by month on 2025-26 only; the reference line is the player's recent average rounded to x.5 (no historical prop lines were reachable).

props_priced.status: no Action Network props on disk

backtest.leakage: PASS: no feature on or before the scrambled date moved; later rows did (features do use the past)
backtest.game_line_verdict: No closing lines available to test the model against; the close is the benchmark (Levitt 2004), so the market is used.

rules: Out and Doubtful players are removed before simulation; day-to-day players are flagged to check news.
Fewer than 5 prior NBA games = out of distribution: no prediction.

Lean: market passed the 2025-26 walk-forward gate (CRPS beats a naive baseline, calibrated log loss beats 50/50 and the base rate, 80% interval covers 75-85%), calibrated chance 55% or more, no flags.

Bet: lean, and the market also beat the no-vig line at real prices out of sample (300+ priced outcomes), edge of 3+ points at the best price, and the 10th percentile of the bootstrap-by-game interval above break-even.
No bet above a 75% chance (Lopez, Matthews & Baumer ceiling).
A book is ignored when its no-vig price is more than 8 points from the median of the books (stale price).
Team minutes are constrained to 240 (265 in overtime) in every simulation.
At most 15 bets per slate, 1u each.
meta.staking: Units are Kelly (1956) shrunk by the bootstrap uncertainty (Baker & McHale 2013), 1u = 1% of bankroll, capped at 1u per bet and 15 bets per slate.

funnel.step: Players simulated on the slate (all eight markets)
Model can predict (at least 5 prior NBA games; Out / Doubtful already removed)
Market passed the 2025-26 walk-forward calibration gate (ast, blk, tpm, reb, stl, tov)
Priced at a sportsbook (Action Network: DraftKings, FanDuel, BetMGM, BetRivers, Caesars)
Market also beat the no-vig line at real prices out of sample (none yet)
Edge of 3+ points at the best price, bootstrap interval clears break-even, no flags, under 75% = Bet

meta.histogram_note: 10,000 simulations per game: minutes and stats linked to the game script by a Gaussian copula learned out of sample (2024-25).
meta.method: Minutes: LightGBM quantile regression on role, recent minutes shrunk toward role priors, rest/back-to-backs, blowout risk from the margin model and teammates out. Per-minute rates: LightGBM Poisson on Efron-Morris shrunk rates (PTS, REB, AST, 3PM, PRA, STL, BLK, TOV) with Negative Binomial counts. Pace and scoring: Glickman-Stern evolving team strength. Composed in a 10,000-run game simulation with team minutes held to 240. Features use only earlier games; a leakage test that scrambles one date passes.
notes: Points and PRA: projections only; the model's 80% range was too narrow in 2025-26 validation (coverage 0.73/0.75), so no probabilities are shown for them.
No sportsbook prices were available at build time, so no bets or leans are posted.
